label: SAT total score
definition: Total score on the SAT (Evidence-Based Reading and Writing plus Math, each 200–800), on the 400–1600 scale, ranked against students who took the SAT in the past three graduating classes.
phrasings: what SAT score is the 99th percentile
what is a top 1% SAT score
what SAT score puts you in the top 10%
what percentile is a 1400 on the SAT
